notes.title: Develop report : Hero of Shamo tribe
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/b0213296e9ba3ecf623656a7345ebf376be008e9.gif
Husho Hero of Shamo tribe

I'm developing new content, Hero units.
They are very powerful and able to use abilities costing resource "Food". Heroes have 3 abilities. Each tribe has own heroes.

Now, let me show you the hero of Shamo tribe, Husho.

Husho is a hero of the Shamo tribe, fighting with a strong body and martial arts. His belief inscribed tattoos similar to tribal gods to his own body. He can inspire the surrounding allied units and deliver powerful attacks. If you go to the battlefield with him, you will be able to control the battle as you think.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/60ca99bcbcbdc64558649c1685a9e23ca3ffdb40.pngAbility 1 : Roundhouse kick
http://yodoshi-camp.sakura.ne.jp/tribalsiege/gif/Hu_Abl1.gif
Deal deadly damage to nearby enemies.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/58f8b95d6560e9e02725a7bb31e53f8ba2380355.pngAbility 2 : Swift sliding
http://yodoshi-camp.sakura.ne.jp/tribalsiege/gif/Hu_Abl2.gif
Moves quickly and deal damage to nearby enemies.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/98bdb3c27c25f2db227d4d2824d0dc403812f0aa.pngAbility 3 : Rapid Stance
http://yodoshi-camp.sakura.ne.jp/tribalsiege/gif/Hu_Abl3.gif
Raising him and his nearby allied units' move and attack speed for 15 seconds. Workers can build buildings faster.


Next report will be about Hero of Gusok tribe.
I'll update patch after developing heroes each tribe.

Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: パッチ 0.761 リリース
notes.content:
Hotfix パッチ 0.761 がリリースされました。

 修正点 

    土地の草テクスチャのコントラストを修正
    一部ユニットのPathfindingシステムの見直し


 HUDリメイク 
HUDのリメイクを進めています。HUDのメインカラーを変更したもの:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/c5dafa8a620d8052e239905a48f2c064e279a4ba.png
現行バージョンは緑が主体で、その色が土地の緑と混ざって見にくいという意見が多くありました。大幅変更も視野に入れ、いろいろ試してみようと思います。

 今後 
Minionの戦闘AIの改善を優先し、シングルプレイヤーの洗練化を優先して進めていこうと思います。


今後とも宜しくお願いします。

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: First Patch released.
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Thank you for your opinions. Patch released.

 Changes

    Enabled unit creation canceling (Right-Clicking Button)
    Enabled selecting all units of same type in screen (Double-Clicking Unit)


 BugFixes

    Pathfinding system
    Fog of war system of some buildings bugs
    HUD information bugs
    Multiplayer setting bugs
    Multiplayer too much dead bodies bugs
    Multiplayer Synchronization bugs
    Selecting no unit bug



 Upcoming Updates

I'll fix bugs and start remaking HUD next week. I'll show  you several drafts of new HUD in the middle of next week.


Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: Early Access and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Now Tribal Siege has been to Early Access.(Thank you very much Valve!!)

We need your opinions to make Tribal Siege better. Please tell us what you think.
First, many people say HUD should be remade. So we're going to remake HUD design ASAP. Meanwhile, we also focus on making camera movement better.

 Upcoming Updates 

The first hot fix update will be on June 16th. The update will be contained:

fix HUD information bugs
Enable unit creation canceling
Multiplayer game setting bugs
And more.


Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: Tribal Siege has been released accidentally skipping Early Access.
notes.content:
Our game was scheduled to release on Steam Early Access but accidentally full released.

We're contacting and asking to Valve to remark this game to Early Access.

We fully apologize and please notice this game is Alpha version.

Early Access Notice are below:

Why Early Access?
Full release date will depend a lot on the feedback we receive. A rough estimate would be 3 to 6 months.

Tribal Siege how long will this game be in Early Access??
Full release date will depend a lot on the feedback we receive. A rough estimate would be 3 to 6 months.

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
There are 7 main areas we will work on during Early Access

New playable tribes, maps and missions
Improve game appearance
Steam achievements and trading cards
Campaign mode of each tribes
New rules of game
Sophisticated translations
Linux version

We continue to develop these during Early Access.

What is the current state of the Early Access version?
In its current state, you can still expect to spend hours in Tribal Siege. 
You can play with not only bots in single player mode but also other players all over the world in multiplayer mode using cloud server.
Current version of this game includes 3 playable tribes. We are planning to add more tribes, maps and units during Early Access.

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
Our plan for now is to have the Early Access version slightly cheaper than the full release. Both as a thank you to our testers and to reflect the amount of content that will be added during Early Access.

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
We will be using the Steam Community forums to gather and discuss feedback.
